name: @yottameta/yotta-security-testing
description: YuanCe (元测) — a disciplined, authorization-first AI security-testing methodology: a four-stage (recon → discovery → verification → reporting) web security testing workflow on authorized targets (self-owned assets / SRC bug bounty / CTF / local labs), with a built-in Scope Guard (allowlist, target triage, blacklist, audit trail, legal redlines) and zero executable payloads. Triggers: authorized security / penetration / vulnerability assessment requests, SRC bug bounty, CTF or lab drills (DVWA / Juice Shop / HTB / VulnHub). Boundaries: unauthorized targets rejected by default; no payloads / evasion / phishing / social engineering; no mass scanning or exploit automation; human review required.
